gloss: already read; read (of a message or document)

definitions.explanation: Indicates that something (a book, message, email, or document) has already been read.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{読|よ}み{済|ず}みだ。
{読|よ}み{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦フォルダ→フォルダ：05394_foruda⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移動|いどう}した→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧。
examples.english: I moved the emails I had already read to a folder.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}み{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古紙回収|こしかいしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I put out the newspapers I had finished reading for paper recycling.

notes:
The {済|す}み component comes from ⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (to be done, to be finished). Common in both physical contexts (books, documents) and digital messaging.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読|よ}み{済|ず}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mark as read (apps usually say ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧)
- {読|よ}み{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: read emails
- ⟦{未読|みどく}→未読：07733_midoku⟧ (unread) ↔ {読|よ}み{済|ず}み (read) — in apps the standard pair is ⟦{未読|みどく}→未読：07733_midoku⟧ ↔ ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧: read (especially in LINE context); same meaning but shorter; used in ⟦{既読|きどく}スルー→既読スルー：10294_kidokusuruu⟧ (seen but no reply)
- ⟦{未読|みどく}→未読：07733_midoku⟧: unread — the opposite
